div.h1:
Nice to meet you!
I'm Dymoob — also known as TechPanda.
div.p: Dev under construction. Vocalist by soul. Stubborn enough to learn everything from scratch.

div.p: I am the founder and lead vocalist of Master Dy, bringing the discipline of stage performance to the world of software development.
With over 10 years of experience in self-taught HTML editing, I've transitioned from hobbyist to professional learner. Currently, I am deeply focused on mastering the C# and .NET ecosystem.
